race.description: Sir Franklin For The Kosi Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: Competitive contest to end the day. COUGARS (3) racing well in stronger company and should be close to his top now third up. Went forward and stuck on well over the closing stages with a close-up fourth over 1300m at Canberra in a TAB Fed Open. All four wins have come over this distance and has solid top three claims. MAGNARDO (9) hard fit for this and maps well with the good weight drop. Never comfortable in the heavy (10) going with a tiring fifth over 1180m at Gundagai. Value contender. RUBI AIR (8) was a month between runs with a fading seventh over 1200m at Wagga on the heavy (10) track. Will relish the firmer surface and expected to bounce back in a winnable race. SPIRITS BURN DEEP (10) demolished a good field last start on the heavy (10) surface with a solid come from behind victory over 1180m at Gundagai in BM66 grade. Hard to stop in this vein of form with the claim.
race.rail_position: Out 3m from 1000m to 380m then cut away rail..
